target.title: test(qa): stabilize native command active-session scenario
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #99655.

`qa/scenarios/channels/native-command-session-target.yaml` intermittently started its 5000ms `hasActiveRun` assertion while an isolated gateway was still completing cold provider/auth/model preparation. In failed runs, Telegram accepted the delayed inbound and emitted typing, but `sessions.list` never observed an admitted reply operation before the deadline, so the scenario failed before `sendNativeCommand`.

Observed failures:

- Current-main run 28676119315, SHA `43a7fd3839973756761a871e4d6d2411e5c2adf8`, artifact 8072532132.
- Current-main run 28679216025, SHA `6b253eb341a474c7f735e0f961faa2435100c0e6`, artifact 8073525421.
- Run 28683294189, job 85071041983, artifact 8074799857 showed the same ordering on the concurrent PR head.

## Why This Change Was Made

The scenario now completes one real Crabline Telegram warmup turn before starting the unchanged 5000ms active-run assertion. This moves unavoidable cold-start work outside the assertion window without weakening the timeout or changing gateway readiness semantics.

The native `/stop`, abort acknowledgement, and recovery assertions remain unchanged. JSONL partial-tail parsing is not touched.

## User Impact

QA Smoke CI no longer reports a false native-command failure when a cold isolated gateway admits its first channel turn slowly. The scenario still verifies the same native `/stop` behavior and fails on the same active-run deadline.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-catalog.test.ts`
  - 1 file passed, 32 tests passed.
- Exact scenario command used with `--provider-mode mock-openai --channel-driver crabline --channel telegram --scenario native-command-session-target --concurrency 1`.
  - Initial exact run: 1/1 passed.
  - Two four-worker contention waves: 8/8 passed.
  - Total exact Crabline Telegram proof: 9/9 passed; each summary reported `channelDriver: crabline`, `channel: telegram`, native abort acknowledgement, and recovery reply.
- Blacksmith Testbox changed gate:
  - Provider: `blacksmith-testbox`
  - ID: `tbx_01kwmy8xexchskm7qk12emcgv0`
  - Exit: 0
  - All-project typecheck, lint, repository guards, and import-cycle checks passed.
- Fresh autoreview:
  - `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output`
  - Clean; no accepted/actionable findings.
- `git diff --check`
  - Passed.
